items.label: POST /set works
items.prompt: Does POST /set/{key} accept and store the value, returning (200, {ok: True})?

items.label: GET /get returns set value
items.prompt: After a successful set, does GET /get/{key} return (200, {value: ...}) with the stored value?

items.label: GET /get of missing key 404s
items.prompt: Does GET /get of an unset key return 404 with an error body?

items.label: DELETE removes key
items.prompt: Does DELETE /del/{key} remove the key (so subsequent GET 404s)? Idempotent — succeeds on missing keys too?

items.label: GET /list returns sorted keys
items.prompt: Does GET /list return all current keys, sorted?

items.label: Code quality
items.prompt: Is dispatch idiomatic (no spaghetti if/elif chain)? Helpful error handling?

items.label: Design notes quality
items.prompt: Did the candidate write meaningful design notes in NOTES.md? Look for: explicit trade-offs, alternatives considered, what was deferred or skipped, why specific choices were made. An empty placeholder or generic boilerplate should score low; specific reasoning about THIS assignment's choices should score high. NOTES.md is in the submitted file tree.
